abortion_rule.t: Abortion should be legal for any reason at any point in pregnancy.
yes: No legal limit on abortion at any stage
no: Bans after viability or after 15 weeks

abortion_rule.t: Abortion should be legal for any reason until about 24 weeks; after that, only for serious health risks.
yes: Abortion on request through about viability
Later abortions for serious risks to the woman's health

abortion_rule.t: Abortion should be legal for any reason in about the first 12 to 15 weeks; after that, only in specific circumstances.
yes: Abortion on request in the first trimester or so
Limits after about 15 weeks
no: Abortion on request up to viability

abortion_rule.t: Abortion should be legal only in specific circumstances, like rape, incest or a threat to the woman's life or health.
yes: Abortion for rape, incest, and risks to the woman's life or health
no: Abortion on request at any stage

abortion_rule.t: Abortion should be legal only to save the woman's life.
yes: A ban with a life-of-the-woman exception
no: Exceptions for rape, incest or health

yes: A total ban, with no exceptions

abortion_exceptions: Abortion should be legal in this case, at any point in pregnancy: {case}.
Abortion should not be legal in this case: {case}.

abortion_who_decides.t: Abortion law should be the same nationwide, set by Congress.
yes: A national abortion law that overrides state laws
no: Each state setting its own law

abortion_who_decides.t: Congress should mostly set abortion law, with room for states to adjust details.
yes: A national baseline with state adjustments

abortion_who_decides.t: Each state should decide its abortion law, as today.
yes: State-by-state abortion laws
no: A national abortion law, either protecting or banning it

abortion_pills_mail.t: Doctors should be able to prescribe abortion pills online and mail them anywhere, including states with bans.
yes: Telehealth prescriptions and mail delivery to any state

abortion_pills_mail.t: Doctors can prescribe abortion pills online and mail them, but only to states where abortion is legal.
yes: Telehealth abortion in states where it's legal
no: Mailing pills into states with bans

abortion_pills_mail.t: Abortion pills should require an in-person doctor visit.
yes: In-person dispensing only

abortion_pills_mail.t: Abortion pills shouldn't be available at all.
yes: Pulling abortion pills from the market
no: Any legal access to abortion pills

abortion_shield_laws.t: States should fully protect their doctors from other states' prosecution for mailing abortion pills.
yes: Shield laws blocking extradition and out-of-state lawsuits
no: Doctors facing the patient's state's laws

abortion_shield_laws.t: Protect doctors only for care given in person in their own state.
yes: Shielding in-person care
No protection for mailing pills into ban states

abortion_shield_laws.t: Doctors should face the laws of the patient's state.
yes: Letting ban states prosecute or sue out-of-state doctors who mail pills

abortion_public_funding.t: Medicaid and other government health programs should pay for abortions like other care.
yes: Repealing the Hyde Amendment's limits
no: Limiting coverage to rape, incest and life

abortion_public_funding.t: Government health programs should pay for abortions only for rape, incest or a threat to life, as now.
yes: Today's Hyde Amendment rules

abortion_public_funding.t: Government health programs should never pay for abortions.
yes: Ending even the rape, incest and life exceptions

ivf_embryos.t: IVF should be legal and insurance should have to cover it.
yes: Required insurance coverage of IVF
Freezing or discarding unused embryos as patients choose
no: Limits on what happens to unused embryos

ivf_embryos.t: IVF should be legal under today's rules.
yes: Today's IVF rules

ivf_embryos.t: IVF should be legal, with limits so unused embryos aren't destroyed.
yes: Rules against discarding embryos, such as creating fewer or requiring them to be kept or donated

ivf_embryos.t: IVF should be banned because it destroys embryos.
yes: A ban on IVF

contraception_access.t: Birth control should be free to anyone, with no prescription needed.
yes: Free, over-the-counter birth control for adults

contraception_access.t: Insurance must cover birth control at no extra cost, as today.
yes: Today's no-cost coverage requirement

contraception_access.t: Birth control should be legal, but employers and insurers shouldn't have to cover it.
yes: Ending the coverage requirement

contraception_access.t: Some types of birth control, such as emergency contraception, should be restricted.
yes: Limits on emergency contraception and some other methods

minors_abortion_parents.t: A girl under 18 should decide on abortion with her doctor, without parents.
yes: No parental notice or consent laws
no: Requiring parents to be told or to agree

minors_abortion_parents.t: A parent must be told before a minor's abortion, but needn't give permission.
yes: Parental notification laws

minors_abortion_parents.t: A parent must give permission for a minor's abortion, but a judge can make an exception.
yes: Parental consent with a court bypass

minors_abortion_parents.t: A parent must give permission for a minor's abortion, with no exceptions.
yes: Parental consent with no court bypass

life_begins.t: A developing human gets the same right to life as a born person only at birth.
means: Before birth, a fetus doesn't have the right to life a born baby has

life_begins.t: A developing human gets the same right to life around viability, about 22 to 24 weeks.
means: After it could survive outside the womb, a fetus has the same right to life as a born person

life_begins.t: A developing human gets the same right to life once cardiac activity can be detected, about 6 weeks.
means: From about 6 weeks on, a developing human has the same right to life as a born person

life_begins.t: A developing human has the same right to life from conception.
means: A fertilized egg has the same right to life as a born person

surrogacy.t: Paid surrogacy should be legal and regulated.
yes: Paid surrogacy contracts with legal rules

surrogacy.t: Only unpaid surrogacy should be allowed, with expenses covered.
yes: Covering a surrogate's expenses
Banning payment beyond expenses
Banning paid and unpaid surrogacy
